description: Upload a custom sticker from an image URL. Discord requires png, apng, or gif at 320x320 pixels and up to 512 KB. Servers start with five sticker slots; boosts add more.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

image_file.description: A png or gif file in the local files folder (DISCORD_MCP_FILES_DIR), by name, instead of a link. Only that folder is read, and only when it is set.

image_url.description: Public http or https link to the image file itself.

tags.description: Comma separated keywords, or one emoji name for autocomplete.

name: create_sticker
title: Create sticker
